Girişdə parolla yanaşı telefonunuzdakı k: At sign-in you are asked for the code from your phone as well as your password.
Parolunuz oğurlansa belə, telefonunuz ol: Even if your password is stolen, nobody can sign in to your account without your phone.
İşçi hesabında məcburidir. Telefonu itir: Mandatory for staff accounts. If you lose your phone, an administrator resets it.
Autentifikator tətbiqindəki 6 rəqəmli ko: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app. If you do not have your phone, enter one of your recovery codes.
İşçi hesabları üçün ikinci addım məcburi: Two-step sign-in is mandatory for staff accounts.
Telefonunuzda autentifikator tətbiqini a: Open an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, FreeOTP) and scan the QR code.
Skan etmək mümkün deyil? Açarı əl ilə ya: Cannot scan? Enter the key by hand
Telefonu itirsəniz, bu kodlarla daxil ol: If you lose your phone, you will sign in with these codes. Each code works once. Print them or keep them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.
